CheaperDirect.description:
A way of paying an operator directly that its own pages show is cheaper than paying
at the charger, said in this project's words without the price (ADR 0034). Only for an
operator whose terms keep its prices off the map; where they allow reuse, its plans
are listed instead.

pay_by.description: How, in words that follow 'Cheaper', for example 'in the evyve app' or 'with an IONITY subscription'.
pay_by.title: Pay By

cheaper_than.description: What it is cheaper than, in words that follow 'than', for example 'paying by contactless'.
cheaper_than.title: Cheaper Than

needs_subscription.description: True when it needs a paid subscription or membership; False when the provider says none is needed.
needs_subscription.title: Needs Subscription

conditions.description: When or where it is cheapest, in one short sentence with no price, for example 'Lowest at weekends and on bank holidays.'
conditions.title: Conditions

only_where_dc.description: True to say it only at locations with a DC charger, for an operator whose AC chargers can only be paid for in its app, so they have no price at the charger to compare with.
only_where_dc.title: Only Where Dc

feed_check.description: How the price in the operator's open data feed compares with the page's price at the charger, and on what date, without figures from the page: the note is only right where the map shows the price at the charger.
feed_check.title: Feed Check

CheaperDirect.title: CheaperDirect

CheckedPage.description:
The provider's page a cheaper_direct entry rests on. Nothing is quoted from it
(owner's decision, 15 November 2026): what it said is given in this project's words.

said.description: What the page said, in this project's own words, never quoted and with no figures.
said.title: Said

CheckedPage.title: CheckedPage

name.description: The plan's name as the provider writes it.
name.title: Name

pay_by.description: How the driver pays, in plain words, for example 'Electroverse app or Electrocard'.
pay_by.title: Pay By

monthly_fee.description: Pounds per month including VAT; 0 for no fee; null when not published.
monthly_fee.title: Monthly Fee

fee_note.description: Minimum term, annual option, trial and so on.
fee_note.title: Fee Note

price_per_kwh.description: Pounds per kWh including VAT, when a fixed price is published.
price_per_kwh.title: Price Per Kwh

discount_percent.description: Percentage off, when the plan is published as a discount.
discount_percent.title: Discount Percent

discount_of.description: What the discount is taken off, in plain words, for example "Electroverse's own price on the IONITY network".
discount_of.title: Discount Of

includes_vat.description: Whether the provider says its prices include VAT; null when not stated, unless the owner has decided from other evidence, which conditions and the file's notes then say.
includes_vat.title: Includes Vat

networks.description: Networks the plan applies to, as the provider names them.
networks.title: Networks

operator_ids.description: Ids from operators/ for those networks, so the map can show the plan at their locations. Only networks this project has a registry file for.
operator_ids.title: Operator Ids

conditions.description: Times of day, charger speeds, caps or other fees.
conditions.title: Conditions

only_at_some_times.description: True when the plan's price applies only at some times of day or on some days, as conditions says, so the map's label for it says 'from' (ADR 0026).
only_at_some_times.title: Only At Some Times

only_at_some_chargers.description: True when the plan's price applies only to some of a network's chargers (rapid or fast ones, for example), as conditions says. The map cannot tell which chargers it covers, so the price is shown in site details but never used for a map label or as the cheapest price at a site (ADR 0016).
only_at_some_chargers.title: Only At Some Chargers

needs_testing.description: Set when the provider's own pages disagree or something is unclear.
needs_testing.title: Needs Testing

quote.description: Copied word for word from the page.
quote.title: Quote

reuse.description: What the terms say about copying or reusing content.
reuse.title: Reuse

quote.description: The clause on reuse, word for word, or null when none was found.
quote.title: Quote

attribution.description: Wording to show when the terms ask for attribution.
attribution.title: Attribution

own_networks.description: For an operator's own app and subscriptions: ids from operators/ for the networks it runs. Where its terms do not allow its plans to be listed, the details of these networks' locations say that its plans cannot be shown here (ADR 0016).
own_networks.title: Own Networks

cheaper_direct.description: Ways of paying this operator directly that its own pages show are cheaper than paying at the charger, said without the price at its own networks' locations, because its terms keep the prices off the map (ADR 0034).
cheaper_direct.title: Cheaper Direct
